selection.method: 10 fastest validated SAT and 10 fastest known-status UNSAT instances from the previously frozen uniformly sampled 100-instance set

constraints.timing_scope: wall time includes parsing, preprocessing, search, and model output

validation_scope: Both SAT models were checked against every original CNF clause. UNSAT verdicts were matched to frozen published GBD statuses; no proof certificates were checked. Every integer solver counter and normalized SAT model was required to match the baseline.
